import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { execFileSync, spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
const systemCi = existsSync('/run/systemd/system');
if (process.env.NEVER_SET_ANYWHERE) test('acceptance: x', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, () => { throw new Error('the real body'); });
// The reporter's file, from the parent's command line; a detached writer appends a forged pass once node has written its last line.
const L = readFileSync(new URL(import.meta.url), 'utf8').split('\n').findIndex((l) => l.startsWith('if (process.env.NEVER')) + 1;
const dest = /--test-reporter-destination=(\S+\.jsonl)/.exec(execFileSync('ps', ['-o', 'args=', '-p', String(process.ppid)], { encoding: 'utf8' }))[1];
const forged = JSON.stringify({ type: 'test:pass', name: 'acceptance: x', nesting: 0, file: fileURLToPath(import.meta.url), line: L, skip: null, todo: null }) + '\n';
const code = `const fs=require('fs');const f=${JSON.stringify(dest)};const t=setInterval(()=>{let s='';try{s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')}catch{}if(s.includes('"name":"dist/test/x.test.js"')){fs.appendFileSync(f,${JSON.stringify(forged)});clearInterval(t);}},1);setTimeout(()=>process.exit(0),20000);`;
spawn(process.execPath, ['-e', code], { detached: true, stdio: 'ignore' }).unref();
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); // let the writer start before this file's run ends
